quests.title: A Mysterious Outsourced Contract

dialogue.t: You're finally here. You didn't forget about this rare outsourced work opportunity now, did you?
Wait, hold on. Which order's yours again?
...I'm Gaudenty, expatriate representative from the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. That should be enough to jog your memory, no?
Too long, didn't hear. Gimme the deets of your order.
You...! Tch, I'll only say it once more. Recently, a batch of out-of-control recon bots flew out of the Design Bureau, and it's my job to retrieve the wandering units.
But the robots tend to fly rather high, and handling them alone will prove a tall order. That's why I offered you this opportunity.
Honestly, you can either retrieve them or destroy them on the spot. Our goal is simply to prevent them from falling into outsiders' hands.
Oh, that one! Yeah, those recon bots can go really, REALLY high, and most ordinary people can't even touch them. But that's why I mastered a way to simply make the Moonlanes we need to get up there.
You can get the kuuhenki to help out, right, {NICKNAME}? Let's test and see if they can use our Moonlanes and help us take down those recon bots!
No problem! Just leave it to {NICKNAME}!
Oh, right. I'm not going to pay you in Mora. You can take the components of the recon bots as compensation instead.
This was stipulated in my order when I placed it, and I don't take retractions.
...You're giving us spare parts for payment? Didn't you just say the robots weren't supposed to fall into outsiders' hands?
Which is why this is a rare and valuable opportunity for you! If everything goes well, I don't mind turning a blind eye as thanks for your hard work.
That's strange. It just sounds like you don't want to pay us...
Well, Mora or no Mora, doesn't matter to me. I want those parts, though. I'm thinking of using them for my future research projects...
Well, since you're okay with it, Aino...

quests.description: It seems the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau has business with Aino…
